BEGIN
  PERFORM admin.validate_model_catalog_first_token(p_value);
  IF p_value IS NULL
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_value -> 'tiers') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
     OR jsonb_array_length(p_value -> 'tiers') = 0
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_value -> 'default_model_id') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
     OR COALESCE(char_length(trim(p_value ->> 'default_model_id')), 0) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'llm_model_catalog must include nonempty tiers and default_model_id'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_value -> 'tiers') AS tier
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(tier) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR COALESCE(tier ->> 'tier', '') NOT IN ('light', 'standard', 'premium')
      OR COALESCE(char_length(trim(tier ->> 'label')), 0) = 0
      OR COALESCE(char_length(trim(tier ->> 'color')), 0) = 0
      OR jsonb_typeof(tier -> 'sort_order') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
      OR jsonb_typeof(tier -> 'models') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'llm_model_catalog contains an invalid tier' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF (SELECT count(*) <> count(DISTINCT tier ->> 'tier')
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_value -> 'tiers') AS tier) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'llm_model_catalog tier keys must be unique' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_value -> 'tiers') AS tier
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(tier -> 'models') AS model
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(model) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
      OR COALESCE(char_length(trim(model ->> 'id')), 0) = 0
      OR COALESCE(model ->> 'provider', '') NOT IN ('openrouter', 'venice', 'surplus')
      OR COALESCE(char_length(trim(model ->> 'provider_model_id')), 0) = 0
      OR COALESCE(char_length(trim(model ->> 'openrouter_model_id')), 0) = 0
      OR COALESCE(char_length(trim(model ->> 'display_name')), 0) = 0
      OR COALESCE(char_length(trim(model ->> 'tagline')), 0) = 0
      OR jsonb_typeof(model -> 'enabled') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
      OR jsonb_typeof(model -> 'sort_order') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'llm_model_catalog contains an invalid model' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF (SELECT count(*) <> count(DISTINCT model ->> 'id')
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_value -> 'tiers') AS tier
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(tier -> 'models') AS model) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'llm_model_catalog model ids must be unique' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_value -> 'tiers') AS tier
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(tier -> 'models') AS model
    WHERE model ->> 'id' = p_value ->> 'default_model_id'
      AND model -> 'enabled' = 'true'::JSONB
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'llm_model_catalog default_model_id must identify an enabled model'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
END;

DECLARE
  a experience.chat_generation_attempts%ROWTYPE;
  v_scale numeric;
BEGIN
  IF btrim(p_generation_id) = '' OR jsonb_typeof(p_metadata) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid LLM call metadata' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_generation_id IS NULL THEN
    -- A provider that returned no call ID (some Venice responses): the turn's delivered call.
    SELECT a0.* INTO a FROM experience.chat_generation_requests r
    JOIN experience.chat_generation_attempts a0 ON a0.id = r.delivery_attempt_id
    WHERE r.chat_history_id = p_history_id;
  ELSE
    SELECT * INTO a FROM experience.chat_generation_attempts
    WHERE chat_history_id = p_history_id AND generation_id = p_generation_id;
  END IF;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'LLM call identity not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  IF a.provider NOT IN ('openrouter', 'venice') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Provider % metadata is recorded by its own call RPC', a.provider USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  -- Venice "usage" is micro-USD (tokens x per-million price); OpenRouter reports USD.
  v_scale := CASE a.provider WHEN 'venice' THEN 1000000 ELSE 1 END;
  INSERT INTO ops.llm_calls AS l (id, attempt_id, chat_history_id, provider, generation_id, provider_name, model,
    finish_reason, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens, reasoning_tokens, cost_usd, cache_cost_usd,
    cost_source, latency_ms, generation_time_ms, raw_usage)
  VALUES (a.id, a.id, a.chat_history_id, a.provider, a.generation_id,
    left(p_metadata ->> 'provider_name', 512), left(p_metadata ->> 'model', 512),
    left(p_metadata ->> 'finish_reason', 128),
    (p_metadata ->> 'native_tokens_prompt')::bigint, (p_metadata ->> 'native_tokens_completion')::bigint,
    (p_metadata ->> 'native_tokens_cached')::bigint, (p_metadata ->> 'native_tokens_reasoning')::bigint,
    (p_metadata ->> 'usage')::numeric / v_scale, (p_metadata ->> 'usage_cache')::numeric / v_scale,
    CASE WHEN p_metadata ->> 'usage' IS NOT NULL THEN a.provider || '_usage' END,
    (p_metadata ->> 'latency')::numeric, (p_metadata ->> 'generation_time')::numeric,
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_metadata -> 'llm_generation_data') IN ('object', 'array') THEN p_metadata -> 'llm_generation_data' END)
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    provider_name = COALESCE(l.provider_name, EXCLUDED.provider_name),
    model = COALESCE(l.model, EXCLUDED.model),
    finish_reason = COALESCE(l.finish_reason, EXCLUDED.finish_reason),
    prompt_tokens = COALESCE(l.prompt_tokens, EXCLUDED.prompt_tokens),
    completion_tokens = COALESCE(l.completion_tokens, EXCLUDED.completion_tokens),
    cached_tokens = COALESCE(l.cached_tokens, EXCLUDED.cached_tokens),
    reasoning_tokens = COALESCE(l.reasoning_tokens, EXCLUDED.reasoning_tokens),
    cost_usd = COALESCE(l.cost_usd, EXCLUDED.cost_usd),
    cache_cost_usd = COALESCE(l.cache_cost_usd, EXCLUDED.cache_cost_usd),
    cost_source = COALESCE(l.cost_source, EXCLUDED.cost_source),
    latency_ms = COALESCE(l.latency_ms, EXCLUDED.latency_ms),
    generation_time_ms = COALESCE(l.generation_time_ms, EXCLUDED.generation_time_ms),
    raw_usage = COALESCE(l.raw_usage, EXCLUDED.raw_usage),
    updated_at = clock_timestamp();
END

settlement.source:
SELECT h.id, h.user_id, h.model, h.session_id, h.llm_finish_reason, h.llm_charge_id, h.assistant_reply, h.status,
    uc.quote -> 'snapshot', uc.settled_at, a.provider, a.generation_id
  FROM experience.chat_history h
  -- db reorg 6b-1b: quote and settlement live in billing.usage_charges. A turn without a charge id never settles
  -- (reconcileCharge skips it), so it no longer takes a slot of the scan budget.
  JOIN billing.usage_charges uc ON uc.id = h.llm_charge_id
  LEFT JOIN experience.chat_generation_requests r ON r.chat_history_id = h.id
  LEFT JOIN experience.chat_generation_attempts a ON a.id = r.delivery_attempt_id
  WHERE h.created_at >= p_since
    AND uc.quote ? 'snapshot'
    AND uc.settled_at IS NULL
    AND CASE
      WHEN p_scan IN ('openrouter', 'venice') THEN
        h.status <> 'streaming' AND a.provider = p_scan AND a.generation_id IS NOT NULL
      WHEN p_scan = 'surplus' THEN
        h.status <> 'streaming' AND uc.quote -> 'snapshot' ->> 'provider' = 'surplus'
      WHEN p_scan = 'missing_identity' THEN
        a.generation_id IS NULL AND h.created_at < p_identity_before
      ELSE false
    END
  ORDER BY h.created_at, h.id
  LIMIT least(greatest(COALESCE(p_limit, 50), 1), 50)
